title: HD-10 CHINA
description:
Background: Designed by Ye, Taha Elghanai, and Muad Elghanai, based on Fostex’s Army Physical Training Zip Up, the HD-10 was made in Spain on 05/15/2025. The fit and overall design were later updated on 05/30/2025. 

Taha Elghanai and Ye hand-pressed the first version together, with Ye personally hand-placing the print location. Ye would wear this version at Barcelona Airport on 06/03/2026. It'd also be used in Campaign Phototests and have a brown zipper.

The HD-10 China would see its release on Yeezy Supply's China Website for Shanghai ticketholders. Currently, the hoodie is exclusive to this event and has not been released on the main Yeezy website.
